rows.en: Clovis: "...Ugh. Ow, that hurts..."
Miyasco: "...What on earth did you do?"
Clovis: "Seems women just can't understand a man's dreams."
Miyasco: "O-oh... His dreams, you say...?"
Sisk: "Peeping. P-e-e-p-i-n-g!
That's why Ymir was lecturing them."
Yamato: "...I knew it."
Touya: "What the hell are you doing at your age...?"
Gen: "Yeah! That's right!
It's a good thing the Captain found me,
but I missed out on all the food because of you!"
Rosalie: "What are you talking about? You had a feast
at the Burgleys' house!"
Gen: "Huh? You knew about that?"
Clovis: "...And we spent that whole time getting lectured.
It's a damn shame they can't understand a man's dreams."
Aurelie: "...What kind of attitude is that?
I'm so disgusted I don't know what to say."
Ai: "Seriously. You haven't learned a thing.
Maybe that lecture wasn't long enough."
Fain: "How are seven ris, about 4.6 hours, not enough?!
They even hit us if we fell asleep..."
Celica: "Nice little gadget, isn't it? Repentance Buddy No. 1.
It can discharge an electric current too, so it comes in handy
for self-defense."
Clovis: "You put THAT in it?!
No wonder it hurt differently from getting hit..."
Celica: "You brought every bit of it on yourselves."
Arthur: "...Still, I was surprised to find
that Ymir knew about kneeling in seiza.
That doubled the agony."
Tix: "So that's called 'seiza'...
I've never sat in such a torturous position before.
My legs are still shaking."
Ai: "Come on, you wimps! You're men, aren't you?"
Clovis: "Then you try it."
Ai: "But I'm a giiirl!"
Kasumi: "...You weren't with them, Touya-chan.
...I'm glad."
Kasumi: "...I never thought you were the kind of person
who'd do something like that, Fain..."
Fain: "What a blow... Slump."
Ymir: "Everyone, if you ever do anything like that again...
You know what will happen, don't you?"
Clovis: "Well, even if you put it like that..."
Aurelie: "...You want another smack?"
Clovis: "Ask BEFORE you hit me..."
Village Elder: "Oh? Are you all leaving already?"
Ymir: "Oh, thank you for last night.
You even arranged rooms for us."
Village Elder: "Not at all. If you enjoyed yourselves,
that's all the thanks I need. Please come and visit
whenever you like. Ho ho ho ho!"
Kururu: "Are you really leaving?
You could stay a little longer..."
Thora: "You mustn't make unreasonable requests.
Besides, given Prince Tix's position,
it wouldn't be advisable for them to stay here too long."
Kururu: "Because Zigrim and Agarthia are at war?"
Clovis: "That's right. And Zigrim probably isn't too happy
about us being here in the first place.
Especially that president of theirs."
Village Elder: "Perhaps President Horem is sincerely
concerned about this world's future. Only his approach
has been too self-righteous. I've no proof, of course. Ho ho ho."
Xiujian: "In any case, right now we must escort Prince Tix
back to the palace."
Kururu: "I see. I guess there's no helping it, then.
Melvi, Gen, come and visit again!"
Melvi: "We will! And when you come to the Holy Land, Kururu,
let's have a sleepover!"
Kururu: "Of course! I'll definitely come!"
Gen: "I'll come pick you up in Zeifon!"
Rosalie: "What are you talking about?!
Your big sister won't allow that!"
Gen: "Aw, come on! It's not like I'd wear it ou... Ow!"
Kururu: "Ah ha ha ha! Well, I won't get my hopes up."
Touya: "You guys sure made friends fast."
Arthur: "Unlike adults, children aren't bound
by strange notions of pride. They can accept each other right away.
It's one of the gifts we lose as we grow up."
Clovis: "Really? I haven't lost it."
Arthur: "You forgot to grow up."
Clovis: "Maybe. But forcing yourself to grow up
doesn't do you any good."
Aurelie: "You can't always get away with that, though.
Sometimes you have to grow up, whether you like it or not."
Kururu: "What are they talking about?"
Gen: "Who knows? I guess they're saying
it's good that we made friends."
Melvi: "We'll always be friends, riiight?"
Kururu: "Of course!"
Ymir: "Hee hee... Well, shall we be on our way?
Thank you all so much."
Village Elder: "Take care."
Clovis: "See you."
Kururu: "Come visit again, you creepy old man!"
Clovis: "Y-yeah!"
Horem: "It seems they acted
more quickly than I expected."
Cain: "I've taken out insurance.
Heh heh... Lodis... No, I'll wipe royalty itself
off the face of this world..."
Horem: "Weren't you royalty yourself?"
Cain: "A puppet. A powerless figurehead.
And a scapegoat when the time came.
...Well, that doesn't matter.
Nobles, royalty... They have no ambition.
Anyone who accepts the status quo and sinks into obscurity is finished."
Horem: "Harsh words. But there's more to it than that, isn't there?"
Cain: "..."
Horem: "Well, I won't force you to talk,
but you seem to hold a personal grudge against Lodis."
Cain: "Heh..."
Horem: "Oh, yes. While you were playing with your friends,
our research here reached the practical stage."
Cain: "You mean you've produced samples?"
Horem: "Yes. I've already mixed them in with supplies for the front.
Growster happens to be out there,
so I thought we'd test them on his men."
Cain: "Isn't it dangerous to use the samples
in actual combat right away?"
Horem: "Why, at the very worst,
Growster dies. In exchange, we gain a vast amount of experimental data.
It's hardly a significant loss."
Cain: "...I'm glad I didn't make an enemy of you."
Ymir: "An incoming transmission?"
Miyasco: "...This is... It's not on an official channel.
I'll put it on the monitor."
Maki: "...Thank goodness... I got through."
Fain: "M-Maki?! What's wrong?!"
Maki: "Heh heh... I messed up a little..."
Touya: "What the hell happened?!"
Maki: "Sorry, I don't have time to explain...
But I found Ze=Ode's base...
I-I'll send the coordinates now... Ugh..."
Ymir: "A-are you all right?! Does your stomach hurt?"
Miyasco: "She may have internal injuries.
If she doesn't get treatment soon..."
Maki: "Ugh... I-I'm fine. You have to
stop Ze=Ode's insane plan, right?
Then don't worry about me, just..."
???: "Oh...? That toy has a function like that
as well...?"
Ymir: "That voice..."
???: "I told you not to act on your own.
You still haven't learned... You need to be punished!"
Maki: "Gah!"
Fain: "Maki!!"
Maki: "...Urgh..."
Lyle: "..."
Ymir: "It was you, just as I thought."
Lyle: "It's been a while... No, not really.
Have you been well, Wenimas?"
Ymir: "I'm not Wenimas.
I'm her daughter."
Lyle: "That's right... The child of that traitor...
Lenis, the man who stole his own older brother's lover..."
Touya: "!!"
Ymir: "Dr. Lenis...?"
Lyle: "Heh... How ironic. Wenimas and Lenis...
Their descendants stand together in my way once again.
...Well, fine. Come if you dare.
I'll be waiting... If this woman is still alive by then...
Heh heh heh heh..."
Ymir: "I'm the child of Dr. Lenis
and Dr. Wenimas...?"
Ai: "Touya might be Dr. Lenis's descendant, right?
Does that mean... you two are brother and sister?"
Gen: "Why? Big Brother Touya's dad
isn't that Lenis guy, right?
Then wouldn't that mean they're not?"
Ai: "Y-yeah, right! This is all so confusing.
Ha ha ha ha..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "..."
Ai: "...Sorry."
Miyasco: "Oh! The data's coming through!"
Clovis: "Where is it?"
Miyasco: "This is... the site of the old Ze=Ode laboratory!"
Celica: "The laboratory? But that place
was supposed to have been investigated three years ago."
Arthur: "But that man was there too.
I doubt there's any mistake."
Touya: "...A-anyway, let's go. I'm worried about Maki."
Derock: "But... I don't think taking Prince Tix
along like this is a good choice."
Tix: "No, please don't worry about me.
Right now, saving Maki and stopping
Ze=Ode's plan are more important."
Celica: "Tix..."
Tix: "I'll be fine, Sis.
I can't stay a child forever.
I can make my own decisions."
Clovis: "Well said! That's the spirit of a man!"
Ymir: "Y-yes...
But let's at least let them know..."
Miyasco: "His Majesty Lodis is at the front right now.
I think it would be better to contact him
through Lady Ivel..."
Ymir: "Y-yes. Please do..."
Ivel: "...Understood. I'll speak
to the Agarthian government. We should also
let Major Rest know."
Ymir: "Yes. Please do..."
Ivel: "...Ymir.
You mustn't let superficial things disturb you.
You are still yourself..."
Ymir: "Y-yes... I know."
Leone: "Sis... Can I talk to you?"
Sharl: "..."
Leone: "Are we really doing the right thing?
Do we really have to tear down the world as it is by force...?"
Sharl: "This again? I told you.
As long as humanity remains in its present form,
conflict will never disappear from this world. When you seek change,
changing only a part of it is meaningless.
How many times must I tell you?"
Leone: "But... those people..."
Sharl: "They've deceived you. They claim
to act in the name of peace, but all they do
is use Spirit Mechs to crush anyone who opposes them.
In the end, they too rely on force and hurt people."
Leone: "No. They aren't fighting because they want to.
They're all such warm people."
Sharl: "...Sigh."
Leone: "Sis...?"
Sharl: "You've disappointed me.
It seems tools have no need for a will after all..."
Leone: "Ugh... S-Sis... What... are you..."
Sharl: "..."
Leone: "...Why... Tou... ya..."
Bernst: "My, my. That's hardly how one treats a little sister."
Sharl: "This is a family matter.
I don't want you interfering."
Bernst: "Oh? So you consider her family
even though she's manufactured?"
Sharl: "She does carry Father's genes,
after all. More to the point,
are our welcoming preparations complete?"
Bernst: "Yes. Everything is in order."
Sharl: "I see. Then the time has finally come."
Leone: "But..."
Sharl: "Don't you trust Father?"
Leone: "I-it's not..."
Sharl: "Well?"
Leone: "...No. It's not that.
...All right."
Sharl: "Good. Is that all you wanted to say?
Then leave."
Leone: "Okay..."
Bernst: "...Again?"
Sharl: "What's going on?
Aren't her adjustments supposed to be perfect?"
Bernst: "They are. That's why she came to voice her opinion, isn't it?
Of her own free will. It's an achievement
humanity itself has yet to accomplish."
Sharl: "...Are you trying to interfere?"
Bernst: "Perish the thought. I am but the Doctor's
faithful servant..."
Sharl: "That's enough. Are our welcoming preparations
complete?"
Bernst: "Yes. Everything is in order."
Sharl: "I see. Then the time has finally come."
Bernst: "Yes, it certainly has.
Oh, and a transmission was detected upstairs."
Sharl: "From that journalist Lyle captured?"
Bernst: "Yes. She probably told them where we are."
Sharl: "But Lyle hasn't reported..."
Bernst: "He wants to fight Rayblade.
Shall I stop him?"
Sharl: "Yes. I'd rather avoid having it destroyed
like last time... Would you take care of it?"
Bernst: "Understood.
All that remains is to wait for them to arrive."
Sharl: "Perhaps the timing is rather convenient.
I'll report to the Doctor at once.
Let's also test that thing we discussed."
Bernst: "Zelbario...?
Will her mind be all right?"
Sharl: "It hardly matters if it breaks.
Surely she'd be happy to become a foundation for our cause."
Bernst: "...I can hardly believe
she truly wants that, but it's your family's business."
Sharl: "..."
Bernst: "Oh, yes. What shall we do with those people
who came with Dr. Debish?"
Sharl: "Let's have them greet our guests first."
Bernst: "Are you sure?
One of them is a favorite of the Doctor's."
Sharl: "What does he see in such a filthy woman...?"
Bernst: "...Well, I'll do as you say.
I'd rather not make an enemy of you
just yet..."
Doris: "...What's wrong? Why call me out here...?"
Resh: "Boss... You loved Lord Dei, didn't you?"
Doris: "W-where's this coming from...?"
Resh: "I just can't see that man as Lord Dei.
Well, of course I can't. He isn't Lord Dei...
Damn it, I can't explain it,
but I can't bring myself to follow him.
You feel the same way, right, Boss?"
Doris: "...Then what exactly do you plan to do?"
Resh: "If you'd carry on Lord Dei's wishes
and lead us..."
Doris: "I'm afraid that now Ioannis is dead,
and our connections to Zigrim and Bio are gone,
we haven't got the strength to act on our own.
Besides... he is Dei. No, Dei was him."
Resh: "Boss..."
Doris: "I realized that the Dei I loved was him.
Those eyes, filled with such hopelessly deep loneliness...
I fell in love with the man inside Dei."
Resh: "...No..."
Doris: "What?"
Resh: "That can't be. I thought at last, at last
I had a chance...
Ever since that day three years ago, when I first met you..."
Doris: "Resh... You..."
Resh: "I-I've watched you all this time, more than he ever has.
I love you more than that bastard does!
So, so..."
Doris: "Resh... I'm glad you feel that way.
But he's the only one for me.
He's the only one I can love..."
Resh: "No... I... I... Ugh..."
Doris: "...I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Resh..."
Resh: "...Ugh..."
Touya: "Is that laboratory the place
where the explosion happened 109 years ago?"
Ymir: "Yes. It's a lake now, and the laboratory itself
is underwater..."
Ai: "What did you mean about investigating it three years ago?"
Celica: "You know there was another explosion three years ago,
and that led us to predict Ze=Ode's return, don't you?"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, you two!
You were told all this, weren't nyou?!"
Celica: "...Sigh. Anyway, at the time,
the Holy Land sent a survey team to investigate."
Arthur: "And they found nothing suspicious then?"
Celica: "Right. Perhaps we should have kept investigating.
But we couldn't spare anyone from the Spirit Mech Development Project.
That really hurt us."
Touya: "Well, anyway, if they're there,
doesn't that mean it's finally time for the showdown?"
Ymir: "There's every chance it will be.
Be careful, everyone."
Ymir: "There's nothing here..."
Celica: "Sisk, anything?"
Sisk: "Just a moment, please... I've got something!
A response on the biological scan!"
Celica: "Where?"
Sisk: "The building up ahead. I'll put it on screen."
